name: smwmusic-journey-to-silius-take-the-fight-to-them-title-screen-stage-1
title: Journey to Silius - Take the Fight to Them!! ~ Title Screen / Stage 1 & 5 theme (Remix)
description:
Did a 2-in-1 remix of the Title Screen theme and the Stage 1 & 5 theme from Journey to Silius. Originally, this was gonna be just the title theme, but given how similar both songs do sound, I thought doing a 2-in-1 would be pretty neat.

Listen, if the title screen of an NES game slaps , then you know the rest of the soundtrack is gonna follow suit. Journey to Silius is the host of one of the most fire OSTs on the NES (and in general) with songs that are upbeat and very catchy / memorable. Here's the playlist on YouTube. Go listen to these songs if you don't believe me.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" is disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. C Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. D Minor (Custom Pitch)
